recommendations.detail: Batch/coalesce wakeups or use polling for the affected producer/consumer pair.
recommendations.rationale: Reduce wakeup-to-idle churn that wastes CPU and perturbs the scheduler.

findings.summary: A large share of wakeups found the task already runnable or did not reach a run before the window ended.

recommendations.detail: Use huge pages / a slab-friendly allocator; reduce small-allocation churn.
recommendations.rationale: Lower fragmentation to keep high-order allocations cheap.

findings.summary: High-order buddy lists are depleted relative to low-order (fragmentation).
